AKI_SISTER_KEYWORD_RED_LEAF_MARK.descrip:
Retain for 1 turn.
When you play or exhaust a Skill with [orange]"Red Leaf Mark"[/orange], gain 1 stack of [gold]Autumn Essence[/gold].
Can overwrite [orange]"Sweet Potato Mark"[/orange]; upon doing so, gain 2 stacks of [gold]Autumn Essence[/gold].
Removed when sent to the discard pile.
